notes.title: 🛠️ Post-Launch Hotfix Now Live – Patch Note
notes.content:
Hello Renovators! 👷‍♂️🏀🥊

We've just rolled out a quick post-launch hotfix to smooth out a few rough edges and improve your gameplay experience. Thank you for all your feedback and support so far, it helps us make the game better with each update!

🔧 Patch Notes – Hotfix Includes:


 Fixed painting issue on the American Football level

 Resolved issue with Baseball side quests

 Added separate saves at the start of each level to prevent blockers

 Updated Credits list

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2230960/Sports_Renovations/

🚀 Get Sports: Renovations now and start building your dream sports world! Ah, by the way, don't forget to join our community on Discord! :D

notes.title: 📸 Contest - Capture Your Best Screenshot! 📸
notes.content:
We’re happy to announce a special contest for all our amazing players! It's time to grab your cameras and showcase your creativity! 📸 

How to Participate:

1. Capture Your Best Screenshot: Head into the game and take a screenshot that truly highlights your favorite moment, renovation, or scenic view. Show us what makes Sports: Renovations special through your lens!
   
2. Share It With Us: Post your screenshot in this Twitter thread.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43566342/fbd7c8f2f08355b69a223d94fc60792793b93328.jpg

What’s Up for Grabs? 🏆 

The winner will receive an extra game key to give away to a friend. Share the fun and invite someone new to experience the renovation magic!

🗓️ Deadline for Entries: 11.04.2025

The top screenshot will be chosen based on creativity, game design appreciation, and overall visual impact. Get ready to show off your skills and creativity!

Good luck to everyone – we can’t wait to see your screenshots! 😄

notes.title: 🏆 Just 1 Day Left 🏆
notes.content:
It’s happening, Sports Renovations officially launches TOMORROW! 🚀 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43566342/c8eeb7e24b998b5d05f7fa78510dd2211d1c265d.jpg

After months (and years!) of hard work, we’re just one sleep away from handing you the keys to your very own renovation projects.
At this point, we’re feeling a mix of pure excitement and a few last-minute jitters, like an athlete waiting for the final whistle! We can’t wait for you to tear down, rebuild, and restore these abandoned sports venues to their former glory!


 Key infos
 🛠️ Launch Time: March 27h, 16:00 UTC
🏀 Share your progress, before & after screenshots, and favorite moments!

If you haven’t already, wishlist now to be notified the second the game goes live! ⏳ 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2230960/Sports_Renovations/

We’re almost there, see you on our basketball court!
🐐 Goat Gamez

👉 Join the Community on Discord

notes.title: Only 3 Days to Go
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
We can hardly believe it, Sports Renovations is just three days away from launch! 😱🎉
 

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43566342/b78a990f2f9bad804d60ee0855752257e1879993.jpg

We've been working tirelessly to bring you a unique mix of renovation and sports nostalgia, and now, it's almost time for you to grab your tools, and restore those sport facilities to their former glory!

As the big day approaches, we're feeling a mix of excitement and nerves. Seeing all your support, wishlist adds, and messages has been incredible! We can't wait for you to start bringing these forgotten sports venues back to life!

What to Expect on Launch Day

  🏀 A satisfying mix of demolition and renovation gameplay
  🏀 A variety of sports facilities to restore, from old gyms to abandoned stadiums
  🏀 The joy of rebuilding history 


If you haven’t already, wishlist Sports Renovations now to be notified the moment it’s live! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2230960/Sports_Renovations/

And if you’re as hyped as we are, let us know in the comments what you're most excited to renovate first! 🛠️🔥

See you in three days, let’s renovate some sports history together!
🐐 Goat Gamez

notes.title: The demo is now updated!
notes.content:
Hi there, Renovators of the world! 🛠

Just recently we've launched our demo and met with some of you on Gamescom. We've had a great time and we loved the fact that you reacted to our game so positively.

Taking notes from your feedback, we decided to update the demo a bit for an even better experience. Play it - and tell us what you think.

Demo update notes


 Fixed outline on dumpsters
 Fuse VFX loading 
 Ring Assembly position fixes 
 English is now the default language in main menu at the start of the game
 Fixed fuse box mechanic (VFX's behavior after loading the game)
 Fixed task UI status 
 Paint gun audio fixes 
 Task marker fixes on HUB prologue


https://store.steampowered.com/app/2427380/Sports_Renovations_Demo/

notes.title: 🏅 Who's the new publisher? 🏡
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43566342/8dc916dba1867bd3ec95a4f04359bae59f649046.jpg

Hi, 

We're Dear Villagers, the new publisher teaming up with Goat Gamez to present you Sports: Renovations!

If you're a fan of simulation games, you won't want to miss this one—your perfect and only chance to renovate gyms and courts using a variety of tools!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43566342/b09095f877e9efb278fad4ca587da7d08efc713a.png
It's your turn to breathe new life into these sports facilities! You'll experience some of the most rewarding moments as you take on the challenge. Plus, you'll earn money along the way, which you can use to renovate your own hometown court!


        [th]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43566342/4d8d21ccf75c220156c957eabcad01759fac82d2.png[/th]

The game will also be playable at Gamescom 2024 and Pax West! Be the first to start the renovations work!

Otherwise, we're planning to show you more content! Stay tuned!

notes.title: We have a new publisher! Demo postponed to a future Next Fest
notes.content:

Pros:
- The demo will probably be bigger and more successful!

It just makes a lot of sense to postpone it, so thanks for understanding.
